# Project Guidelines

## Code Style
Use semantic HTML and clean CSS. Reference [style.css](style.css) for color scheme (#0056b3 blue, #5f1c1c brown/red, #25d366 green) and responsive layout patterns with Flexbox and media queries. Fix existing CSS syntax errors (missing braces, invalid properties) before adding new styles.

## Architecture
Single-page static landing page for "Etiquetas Autoadhesivas" business. Sections: header with logo, hero with image and text, benefits cards, contact form using Formspree. External dependencies: Google Fonts (fix incomplete link), Formspree for form submission.

## Build and Test
No build tools required. Test by opening [index.html](index.html) in a browser. Validate HTML/CSS with W3C validators. Optimize images in Fotos/ for performance.

## Conventions
Content in Spanish. Use uppercase text selectively for emphasis. Ensure responsive design for mobile (<768px). Avoid duplicating CSS rules; refactor existing styles for consistency.</content>
